title: Terminate the full Engram control process tree on timeout
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport kills its direct wrapper child on timeout/shutdown but does not guarantee descendant termination. Shell/PowerShell wrappers can leave the actual Engram process alive.
acceptance: Unix process groups and Windows Job Objects (or an equivalent cross-platform mechanism) terminate the entire control process tree on timeout, EOF, idle reap, and shutdown, with platform tests.
